Echeveria derenbergii J. A. Purpus, 1921
静夜，由J. A. Purpus发表于1921年。Series Ciliatae
Ciliatae系Distribution: Mexico (Oaxaca: Sierra de Mixteca)
分布于墨西哥Oaxaca州的Sierra de Mixteca。
Description (according to IHSP, 2003):
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem short, multibranching.
短茎，易形成多头。Rosettes 6 – 8 cm in diameter.
莲座：直径约6-8cm。Leaves obovate-cuneate, mucronate, 3 – 4 x 2 – 2,5 cm, 3 – 5 mm thick, light green, ± glaucous, margins and tips often reddish.
叶：倒卵形或楔形，具短尖，3-4cm长，2-2.5cm宽，3-5mm厚，淡绿色，多少具白霜，叶缘和叶尖通常泛红。Inflorescences to 4 or more, cincinni to 10 cm, single or sometimes 2, each with 5 or more flowers, pedicels erect, to12 mm.
花序：4根或更多；上有蝎尾状聚伞花序，约10cm，1支，有时2支，每支上有5朵或更多的花；花梗向上，较长达12mm。Flowers: Sepals ascending to spreading, subequal; corolla erect, 12 – 15 mm long, yellow, keels and tips reddish.
花：萼片向上竖直展开，大小基本相同；花冠向上直立，12-15mm长，黄色，脊线和尖端发红。Cytology: n = 27
染色体：n=27
Note :
请注意：In cultivation E. derenbergii rosettes may reach a diameter of more than 10 cm and also grow higher than the description indicates.
园艺中的静夜莲座可以长到10cm以上，茎部也比描述中的更长。
